$comment: What the creative hotbar places (docs/ITEMS.md; owner, 2026-10-26: "build in 1 m blocks by default in creative, but we're going to be able to build in half blocks too, it's just a different piece (item)"). Each item names the block it places (shared/blocks) and its height in ½ m cells: 2 a 1 m block (two cells against the face aimed at), 1 a ½ m one. A block that brings its own other cells (a torch's flame, `extends`) is a 1-cell item. The order is the hotbar's. Prototype content. Run `node shared/items/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/items.gen.rs is stale.

buildModes.$comment: What holding Place does after the first block (docs/ITEMS.md §5; owner, 2026-10-28): keep building as the aim moves, in the mode chosen. `key` (KeyboardEvent.code) cycles the modes, as does the controller's buildMode button (shared/input/gamepad.json) and the touch Build button; the first is the default. Kinds (the engine's vocabulary, crates/dwell-game/src/build_drag.rs): `line` builds on in a straight line out of the face first clicked, as far as the aim reaches along it; `level` paints the cells the aim sweeps over at the first block's level (floors and ceilings).
